Skillsroad is Australia's #1 destination for Career Advice. Our mission is to empower young people, along with their parents, teachers and future employers to feel confident and supported taking the first steps on their career journey.

What we do? We’re all for the S-word. Like, Skills (sharpening them). Strengths (our sources of success). Space (to explore and survive as many experiences as possible). Soul-searching (to find out what makes you tick). Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious (Something that you totally are – now google it! 😊)

We want you to flourish. Start your journey today: www.skillsroad.com.au
